product_name: Bajaj Life New Critical Illness Benefit Rider
regulatory_descriptor: A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider
key_benefits: Lump-sum Rider Sum Assured on first diagnosis of a covered Critical Illness, subject to surviving 14 days from confirmed diagnosis
Protection against up to 60 major Critical Illnesses across three options: Critical (10), Enhanced (25), Comprehensive (60)
Coverage of women-specific cancers (breast, corpus uteri, cervix uteri, ovary, vulva, vagina) under each option
Limited-pay or regular-pay aligned to the base plan; addable at inception or any policy anniversary subject to underwriting
Optional Health Management Services (medical second opinion, case management, consultation) at no additional cost
Rider Termination Value payable post completion of PPT under limited-pay, or anytime under single-pay

eligibility.policy_term: Aligned to the base Policy Term
eligibility.premium_payment_term: Limited pay or Regular pay, aligned to base plan (Single pay also referenced)
eligibility.note: Numeric eligibility table (entry/maturity ages, sum-assured) not recovered from this brochure parse. Verify against policy document before asserting numeric limits.

key_terms.free_look_note: Free look period is as per the base policy.
key_terms.survival_period: 14 days — Rider Sum Assured paid only if the Life Assured survives 14 days from the date of confirmed diagnosis.
key_terms.maturity_benefit_condition: No maturity benefit; this is a pure-risk health rider. Rider Termination Value (SSV factor x Total Premiums Paid) payable only under limited-pay (post-PPT) or single-pay; none under regular-pay.
key_terms.tax_note: Tax benefits 'as per applicable tax laws as amended from time to time'; consult a tax consultant. GST and cess collected over and above premium.

mandatory_disclosures_present: Detailed Critical Illness definitions, conditions and exclusions

claims_marketing_must_support: This is a RIDER, not a standalone policy — every claim must reference that it attaches to and depends on a base policy.

The number of conditions covered is option-specific: Critical = 10 CIs, Enhanced = 25 CIs, Comprehensive = 60 CIs; '60 critical illnesses' applies ONLY to the Comprehensive option and must be qualified.

Each Critical Illness pays only if its strict policy definition / severity threshold is met (e.g. specified NYHA class, imaging/histology, 6-week permanence, 3-of-6 ADL failure); not in plain-language terms.
Benefit is payable on FIRST diagnosis only and only if the Life Assured survives the 14-day Survival Period.
Rider Termination Value availability is pay-mode-bound (none under regular-pay).
claims_marketing_must_avoid: Do NOT market as a standalone health/insurance plan — it cannot be sold without a base policy.
Do NOT imply maturity, savings, surrender or loan value — there is no maturity benefit; termination value is limited and pay-mode dependent.
Do NOT state a flat '60 critical illnesses' without naming the Comprehensive option; the Critical and Enhanced options cover fewer.
Do NOT omit the 14-day Survival Period and the per-illness definitions/exclusions when describing the benefit.
Do NOT present Health Management Services as guaranteed — they are optional, third-party, and may be discontinued.
Tax benefits must not be stated as assured — always carry the 'as per applicable tax laws' caveat.
must_state: Full regulatory descriptor: 'A Non-Linked, Non-Participating, Individual, Pure Risk Health Rider'
That the rider attaches to a base policy and that CI definitions, the 14-day Survival Period and exclusions apply
Standard disclaimer to read the rider sales literature and policy document before concluding a sale
